department: The Solomon H. Snyder Department of Neuroscience (School of Medicine)

deadline.value: Completed applications including letters are due December 1, 2026, earlier than other School of Medicine programs.
deadline.quote: The deadline for submission of completed applications including letters of recommendation December 1, 2026.

app_fee.value: School of Medicine fee is USD 125 and covers up to four programs.
app_fee.quote: An application fee of $125 is required and must be submitted using a credit card.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers need low US income, US military service, or alumni of Maryland colleges or certain JHU programs, so most international applicants will not qualify.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are available to prospective students who meet one or more of the three eligibility criteria described below.

gre_general.value: The program does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: NOTE: The Neuroscience Program DOES NOT require GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: School of Medicine sets the TOEFL minimum and the department page does not state it, so the Krieger rule is not shown.

ielts_min.value: School of Medicine sets the IELTS minimum and the department page does not state it, so the Krieger rule is not shown.

english_waiver.value: The TOEFL requirement is waived if your degree is from an institution where English was the primary language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL requirement is waived for students who have studied at a university within the U.S. or if you received your degree from an institution where English was the primary language of instruction.

funding.value: Accepted students receive stipend, tuition waiver and insurance, but international funding is more limited because NIH support is for US citizens and residents.
funding.quote: All students accepted into the Neuroscience Training Program will receive a living allowance in the form of a stipend, full tuition waiver, and health and dental insurance. | Funding for International students is more limited

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to hold a BS or BA before enrolling.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have received a B.S. or B.A. prior to enrolling in the graduate program.

supervisor.value: Applicants name faculty of interest in the statement but no supervisor agreement is required.

gre_subject.value: The pages checked do not state the GRE Subject test.
